cases.name: Amanda Rae Robertson
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Amanda graduated with honors from Franklin County High School. She was a Homemaker to her four children and homeschooled them. She enjoyed all things nature, and creating a new way of living life; that challenges societal systems or conditioned beliefs."

Her Go Fund me said, "She possessed a shining soul and free spirit that loved everyone she met, and the feelings were shared by those who had the chance to meet her."
